swaps.why_in: "Whenever you gain life, you may pay {X}, where X is less than or equal to the amount of life you gained. If you do, draw X cards.": every Paradox lifegain event from a loyalty activation becomes a card.
swaps.why_out: Chandra, Fire Artisan shares her type with Chandra, Torch of Defiance, so cutting her leaves Tam X unchanged.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: a per-event draw engine for a duplicate-type walker.

swaps.why_in: "+1: Add {R} or {G}.": a new walker type (Tam X+1) whose +1 is ramp and triggers Paradox and Mentor on every activation.
swaps.why_out: Rewrite Regrets needs a creature or planeswalker card in the graveyard, so it is dead early.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: refuter round-1 coverage miss #1, adopted in the Tam section-6 baseline in place of the Dina fallback.
swaps.note: Rewrite Regrets also empowers Jace 2 (Jace-empower package); operator may want to confirm.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever you gain life, target opponent loses that much life.": drains once per lifegain event (Paradox, Liliana the Faultless, Ajani).
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Archangel's 'creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {1}' is the only static walker protection.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the auditor's 'zero line to the plan' is false; the round-1 fallback OUT (Final Act) is now a Tam lock.
swaps.note: Final Act became a Tam lock after round 1.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever you gain life, each opponent loses 1 life.": pings each opponent on every lifegain event.
swaps.why_out: Not cuttable: Jared is the only Jared-type walker (Tam X-1 if cut) and a Tam lock.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: cuts a unique walker type; the round-1 fallback slot (Rewrite Regrets) went to Domri.
swaps.note: Jared is a Tam lock.

swaps.why_in: "Destroy target artifact, creature, or planeswalker.": flexible instant removal.
swaps.why_out: Not cuttable: a Talisman is ramp at 35 locked lands; the cut moved the gate's land target from 38 to 39.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the deck already runs 7 spot removal and {B}{B}{R} is the hardest pip cost in a five-colour base.
swaps.note: Both Talismans are Tam locks.

swaps.why_in: "Target player draws two cards and loses 2 life.": two cards for 2 mana.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Vigorbloom's 'You draw a card and gain 3 life' is a card plus a Mentor lifegain event, and its other mode gives a walker hexproof and indestructible.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the auditor's claim that Kaya's Ghostform covers hexproof is false; Ghostform returns a card, it grants no hexproof.

swaps.why_in: "Draw three cards.": three cards for 4 mana.
swaps.why_out: Not cuttable: the second Talisman is ramp at 35 locked lands; cutting both leaves 9 ramp pieces.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: same ramp objection as Bedevil.
swaps.note: Both Talismans are Tam locks.

swaps.why_in: "You draw X cards and lose X life, where X is the number of colors of mana spent to cast this spell.": it costs {2}{B}, so X is at most 3, not the auditor's 'likely 5'.
swaps.why_out: Not cuttable: Saheeli is the only Saheeli-type walker (Tam X-1) and makes a Servo on 'Whenever you cast a noncreature spell'.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: cuts a unique walker type, and the IN math is wrong.
swaps.note: Saheeli is a Tam lock.

swaps.why_in: "Create an 8/8 blue Leviathan creature token with hexproof": every walker gets a [-8] finisher once Mentor has built loyalty.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Pia's 'search your library for an enchantment card' is the only tutor for the Ways, including the Mentor + Paradox engine.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the auditor's 'RNG-gated' is false (the search is a choice); Kiora is a payoff, Pia assembles the engine.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever you gain life, you may pay that much life. If you do, draw that many cards.": draws on each Paradox lifegain event.
swaps.why_out: Not cuttable: Quintorius is the only Quintorius-type walker, so cutting him lowers Tam X by 1.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: unique walker type lost for a 6-MV {2}{W}{W}{B}{B} card the operator may not own.
swaps.note: IF-OWNED.

swaps.why_in: No card added: size fix, 101 to 100 cards.
swaps.why_out: Creakwood Liege is the 101st card; it is absent from the operator's own 100-card proposals/meren-powerhouse.txt.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: mandatory size fix that keeps 35 lands and a lands PASS (replaces the rejected Swamp cut).

swaps.why_in: "When Vraska enters, if you control six or more lands, destroy target permanent an opponent controls.": at MV 3 Meren loops it, so it is repeatable any-permanent removal on a deathtouch body.
swaps.why_out: Lightning Greaves only grants haste and shroud; Meren's value comes from end-step recursion, and Veil of Summer stays as protection.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: valid only because Veil of Summer stays (Silence the Echo swap rejected).
swaps.note: ASSUMED: confirm owned. Freed Greaves: astra-review proposed it for Imotekh (not evaluated).

swaps.in: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
swaps.why_in: "Whenever you gain life, target opponent loses that much life.": doubles every 1-life gain from Blood Artist, Zulaport, Cauldron and Moldervine into a second loss.
swaps.why_out: Grim Servant is a 4-MV tutor that costs 3 life; the weakest creature slot, though Meren can recur it.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: Vito is the stronger drain payoff.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever this creature enters or attacks, create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.": sac fodder on every entry and attack, and an MV-6 reanimation target.
swaps.why_out: Rune-Scarred Demon is a one-shot tutor body at the same MV with no fodder.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP.

swaps.why_in: "{T}: Add {B} or {G}.": coloured mana for {B}{B}{B} and {B}{B}{G}{G} costs, plus 1 life on entry.
swaps.why_out: High Market's free sac-for-1-life outlet is redundant with 4 other free outlets and makes only colourless.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP (reason fixed: Grim Backwoods is not an 'identical template'; it costs {2}{B}{G}).

swaps.why_in: "You draw two cards and lose 2 life.": two cards for 2 mana.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Butcher's 'Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, each opponent sacrifices a creature' is a one-sided repeatable edict.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: Butcher is an engine piece, and the operator cut Night's Whisper from Meren in v6.
swaps.note: Operator declined Night's Whisper for Meren.

swaps.why_in: No card added: proposed size fix, 101 to 100 cards.
swaps.why_out: Cutting a Swamp drops Meren to 34 lands and adds a new gate WARN (current deck: lands PASS at 35).
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: cut Creakwood Liege instead.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever Avacyn or another nontoken creature you control dies, return that card to the battlefield under your control at the beginning of the next end step.": team-wide free reanimation off every sacrifice.
swaps.why_out: Not cuttable: operator keep (HISTORY: 'The Gitrog, Ravenous Ride stays').
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the OUT is an operator keep; at MV 8 Meren mostly returns Avacyn to hand; IF-OWNED.
swaps.note: Operator keep.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever another creature or planeswalker you control dies, Massacre Girl deals 1 damage to target opponent and you gain 1 life.": a single-opponent drain on each death.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Golgari Charm's regenerate mode makes Culling Ritual a one-sided wipe (HISTORY line 169).
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: Blood Artist, Zulaport, Cauldron, Konrad and Vito already drain.
swaps.note: Two-deck conflict with Imotekh: neither deck gets it.

swaps.why_in: "Destroy target creature or planeswalker.": two-mana removal whose optional sacrifice cost feeds Meren.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Veil's 'Spells you control can't be countered' and hexproof from blue and black are unconditional; with Greaves out it is Meren's last protection.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the auditor misquoted Veil (only the draw is conditional), and removal is already dense.
swaps.note: Conflicted with the Vraska swap, whose rationale relies on Veil staying.

swaps.why_in: "Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. You gain 4 life.": any-permanent rebuy plus a Vito trigger.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Marauder's 'each player sacrifices a nontoken creature' repeats every end step through Meren at MV 2.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: Restore duplicates Meren's own recursion.
swaps.note: Two-deck conflict with Cabbage: neither deck gets it.

swaps.why_in: "Add one mana of any color.": every creature token taps for mana, so Najeela's attacking Warrior tokens pay for her WUBRG untap-and-extra-combat: infinite combats.
swaps.why_out: Solemn Doomguide only grants 'unearth {1}{B}' to party cards in the graveyard: grind value on a 5-drop.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: wins the Doomguide slot over Traxos.
swaps.note: Doomguide was proposed as an OUT twice.

swaps.why_in: "Destroy target permanent.": answers any permanent at instant speed.
swaps.why_out: Concerted Defense is a soft counter for noncreature spells only.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP.

swaps.why_in: "You may cast creature spells of the chosen type from the top of your library.": card advantage on a changeling that fills all four party roles.
swaps.why_out: Archpriest of Iona is a 1-drop whose power equals your party size.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: wins the Archpriest slot over Rescue Girl.
swaps.note: Archpriest was proposed as an OUT twice.

swaps.why_in: "Destroy target artifact or creature.": instant removal for two permanent types.
swaps.why_out: Bar the Gate only counters a creature or planeswalker spell.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP.

swaps.why_in: "Destroy target creature. You lose 2 life.": unconditional 2-mana instant removal.
swaps.why_out: Multiclass Baldric is an equipment granting one keyword per party role; the weakest slot.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP (reason fixed: Baldric does not need a full party).

swaps.why_in: "Each other player discards a card. You draw a card for each card discarded this way.": about 3 cards for 4 mana in a 4-player pod.
swaps.why_out: Thwart the Grave is situational graveyard recursion.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP (reason fixed: Thwart costs 1 less per party member, it does not need a full party).

swaps.why_in: "When this creature enters, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment.": the Idol's removal modes on a changeling body that fills any party role.
swaps.why_out: The Idol's only unique mode is a Treasure plus venture.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: wins the Idol slot over Enlightened Confidant.
swaps.note: Cursed Idol was proposed as an OUT twice.

swaps.why_in: "Creatures you control have haste.": a 2-mana Human Warrior Cleric (two party roles) that hastes the team.
swaps.why_out: Feywild Caretaker is 5 mana for one Wizard plus the initiative; Wizards stay at 6 plus the changelings.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: the auditor omitted Caretaker's initiative, but Samut still wins on rate.
swaps.note: ASSUMED: confirm owned.

swaps.why_in: "{T}: Return another target permanent you control to its owner's hand. Activate only during your turn.": a flying Cleric that re-buys the initiative/venture entries of Seasoned Dungeoneer, White Plume Adventurer and Ravenloft Adventurer.
swaps.why_out: Yuan-Ti Malison is unblockable only when attacking alone and ventures only on combat damage; Rogues stay at 9.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP, moved: the proposed OUT was Archpriest of Iona, whose slot went to Realmwalker.
swaps.note: Moved to the next-weakest slot. ASSUMED: confirm owned.

swaps.why_in: "During your turn, your opponents can't cast spells or activate abilities of artifacts, creatures, or enchantments.": protects combat and combo turns and fills the Cleric role.
swaps.why_out: Stick Together makes every player sacrifice all but a party, hitting Tazri's own Najeela, Squad Commander and Merriment tokens.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP on card quality, but HELD: it reverses the operator's v4 cut.
swaps.note: HELD: reverses operator v4 decision — needs a yes. Not in the 100-card count.

swaps.why_in: "Draw a card. You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.": 2-MV instant ramp that replaces itself.
swaps.why_out: Explore the Underdark is a 5-MV sorcery, though it also fetches two lands and takes the initiative.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP on rate, but HELD: it reverses the operator's v6 add.
swaps.note: HELD: reverses operator v6 decision — needs a yes. Not in the 100-card count.

swaps.why_in: "{G}, {T}: Add X mana in any combination of colors, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.": big ramp off the largest creature.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest (in round 1): Caretaker is an Orc Wizard that Tazri can find, and 'you take the initiative' on entry.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: Selvala is no party type and her draw is symmetric (operator cut her from Cabbage on 09-18).
swaps.note: Caretaker's slot went to Samut in round 2.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever you cast an artifact or creature spell, untap Traxos.": a trampler that untaps on creature casts.
swaps.why_out: Doomguide's slot went to Springleaf Parade.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: a Dragon Construct fills no party role and has no Tazri text.
swaps.note: Two-deck conflict with Cabbage: neither deck gets it.

swaps.why_in: "At the beginning of your end step, if you gained life this turn, surveil 1.": conditional card selection on lifelink turns.
swaps.why_out: The Idol's slot went to Chomping Changeling.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: Tazri has no steady lifegain, and the card is IF-OWNED.
swaps.note: IF-OWNED.

swaps.why_in: "When this creature enters, you may destroy another target creature.": removal on an artifact body the recursion engine can reuse.
swaps.why_out: Canoptek Wraith is a land-fetch creature that must connect and pay {3} first.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP.

swaps.why_in: "When Winter enters, you may sacrifice a creature or planeswalker. When you do, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.": an edict per opponent paid with a Necron token, plus +1/+0 per creature card in the graveyard.
swaps.why_out: Plasmancer is a 4-MV flier whose only text fetches a basic Swamp to hand in a 35-land deck.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: minor cost, Winter is not an artifact card unless Biotransference is out.
swaps.note: ASSUMED: confirm owned.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever a Swamp you control enters, choose one": a card or a 2-damage drain off each of 32 Swamps.
swaps.why_out: Cryptek's {1}{B}, {T} return-on-death protects one artifact creature for one turn.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP (note: Cryptek's own graveyard return is an Imotekh trigger, but Dread Presence is stronger).

swaps.why_in: "it has all activated abilities of all creature cards in all graveyards.": copies Szeras's sacrifice-for-mana, Syr Konrad's mill and Chronomancer's draw from the graveyard.
swaps.why_out: Flayed One is a lifelink body with a one-time mill three.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP (reason fixed: Marionette Master's drain is triggered, so the Ooze does not get it).

swaps.why_in: "put target creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. It gains haste.": steals the best creature in any graveyard, and persist does it twice.
swaps.why_out: Lychguard's only text returns legendary creature cards to hand for {3}{B} and itself.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP.

swaps.why_in: "You draw two cards and lose 2 life.": two cards for 2 mana.
swaps.why_out: Ominous Harvest usually copies 0-1 times off Gravestorm: about one card for 1 life.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: Insatiable Avarice (the operator's 09-09 pick) stays, so nothing is reversed.
swaps.note: Operator owns 2 copies; singleton, so 1 goes here and the 2nd stays in the binder.

swaps.why_in: "Each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.": a modal edict.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Imp's Mischief ('Change the target of target spell with a single target') is Imotekh's only protection.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the report itself calls protection a real gap.

swaps.why_in: "Deathtouch": a deathtouch artifact body.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Razorlash returns itself from the graveyard, usually for {B}{B}, a repeatable Imotekh trigger.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the auditor misread Razorlash as unearth; Skorpekh has no engine text.

swaps.why_in: "This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each creature that died this turn.": a flash body sized by the turn's deaths.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Chronomancer's '{1}, {T}, Sacrifice another artifact: Draw a card' and its unearth are repeatable Imotekh triggers.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: Sautekh has no unearth, so the auditor's 'unearth cost' comparison compares against nothing.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever another creature or planeswalker you control enters, mill two cards.": mills 4 per Imotekh trigger, fuelling recursion.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Apprentice's 'each opponent loses 1 life' on every creature or artifact death is 3 per death in a 4-player pod.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the auditor's 'one-point trickle' misreads 'each opponent'; Apprentice is one of three each-opponent drain payoffs.

swaps.why_in: "Massacre Girl deals 1 damage to target opponent and you gain 1 life.": a single-opponent drain on each death.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Zealot's 'Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Surveil 1' is a free sac outlet, defended in the auditor's own section 6.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: a 5-MV single-target drain that needs an outlet.
swaps.note: Two-deck conflict with Meren: neither deck gets it.

swaps.why_in: "{3}{B}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Return another target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.": one graveyard-to-hand rebuy.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Bauble is ramp, and the auditor's own report says ramp is thin.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: 'repeatable' is false; the cost exiles the Necromancer, so it works once.

swaps.why_in: "Target opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker with the greatest mana value among creatures and planeswalkers they control.": instant edict on the biggest threat.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Wishclaw is one of two library tutors (Insatiable Avarice puts on top; Buried Alive is graveyard-only).
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: a role swap, not an upgrade; spot removal is already 5 pieces plus Noxious Gearhulk.

swaps.why_in: "{T}: Add {G} for each Elf you control.": ramp off 7 Elves that reach the battlefield (Mystic, Llanowar, Jaheira, Halsin, Tireless Provisioner, Disciple, itself).
swaps.why_out: No card cut: size fix, 99 to 100 cards.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP: mandatory size fix; Nesting Grounds stays.

swaps.why_in: "At the beginning of each upkeep, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.": four tokens a round, each also making a Took Food.
swaps.why_out: Emil's Fractal costs {4}{G} and a tap per token.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP.
swaps.note: Emil was an operator add in v3 on 09-28.

swaps.why_in: "If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two cards instead.": doubles the draws from Toski, Ohran, Idol, Took, Uprising and Kenrith's.
swaps.why_out: Ginger was the auditor's weakest-slot pick; the refuter did not contest the OUT.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP (reason fixed: doubling the life amount adds no Trudge Garden triggers; the value is doubled draws).
swaps.note: Ginger was an operator add in v3 on 09-28; confirm.

swaps.why_in: "Exile this card from your hand: Add {G}.": free acceleration.
swaps.why_out: Hungering Puppetbeast is an EDHREC #27440 5-drop whose sacrifice ability grows only itself.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP (reason overstated: its Food sacrifices still feed Trail of Crumbs).
swaps.note: Puppetbeast was an operator add in v4 on 09-28; confirm.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker this turn, draw that many cards.": a big draw off a Trudge Garden 4/4 or a pumped token.
swaps.why_out: Spry and Mighty's X is the difference between two creatures' powers, which is small in a token deck.
swaps.verdict_reason: KEEP.
swaps.note: Spry and Mighty was an operator sleeved pick on 09-18; confirm.

swaps.why_in: "At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are 100 or more tower counters on this enchantment, you win the game.": an alternate-win mana sink.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: The Ooze makes a Mutagen token every turn, which Took and Manufactor multiply into Wurmlet and Trudge Garden triggers.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the auditor quoted only The Ooze's first ability; Pinnacle duplicates the Walking Ballista kill.

swaps.why_in: "Equipped creature gets +3/+0 and has trample and lifelink.": lifelink on one attacker.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Propagator's 'Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life' makes it a second Trudge Garden loop piece.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: lifelink is one lifegain event per damage step.

swaps.why_in: "{T}: Add {G} for each Elf you control.": Elf ramp.
swaps.why_out: Not cuttable: operator keep (HISTORY 09-18), and the cut takes the deck from 33 to 32 lands.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT the OUT only: the Archdruid enters as the 100th card instead (separate KEEP).
swaps.note: Operator keep.

swaps.why_in: "Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn.": one turn of combat protection.
swaps.why_out: No card cut: the auditor proposed it as the 100th card.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: the operator removed Fog in v3 on 09-28; the 100th slot goes to Elvish Archdruid.
swaps.note: Operator removal.

swaps.why_in: "When this creature enters, empower Jace 2.": a 2-loyalty Jace token on a 3-MV artifact body.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Propagator is a round-1-protected Trudge Garden loop piece.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: judged without the false '[-3] right away' claim; empower 2 gives only 2 loyalty.

swaps.why_in: "Whenever you cast an artifact or creature spell, untap Traxos.": a trampler that untaps on casts.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Jiang's end-step untap of all tokens doubles Jaheira token mana; Seedborn Muse covers only opponents' turns.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: no Food, token or lifegain text.
swaps.note: Two-deck conflict with Tazri: neither deck gets it.

swaps.why_in: "Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. You gain 4 life.": one rebuy plus one Trudge Garden trigger.
swaps.why_out: Not the weakest: Titanbones' 'Whenever you gain life, put two +1/+1 counters' scales with every Food sac and grows without bound off the loop.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: not a clear upgrade.
swaps.note: Two-deck conflict with Meren: neither deck gets it.

swaps.why_in: "Enchanted permanent is a Construct creature with base power and toughness 5/5 in addition to its other types.": turns a Manufactor or Idol into a 5/5 and rebuys itself.
swaps.why_out: Not cuttable: Ribtruss is an operator-sleeved pick, and Trudge Garden and Halsin tokens feed its devour.
swaps.verdict_reason: REJECT: a two-card threat that dies to one removal spell; IF-OWNED.
swaps.note: IF-OWNED.
